Customer churn and spending

Results from the supplied development and external CSV files

Run provided-v1. Seed 42.

Study questions and protocol

Can customer attributes discriminate the supplied churn label, and estimate recorded total spending? No dated prediction horizon, spending currency or customer lifetime value is established by these files. CustomerID is excluded from models; Churn is also excluded from spending features.

The development file is stratified 70/15/15. A declared sample of training rows is used for cross-validation; the winner is refitted on all training rows. Validation selects the classification F1 threshold. Internal test and the supplied external file do not select candidates or preprocessing. Between-file diagnostics were inspected during the audit; the external file is a transfer stress test, not an unseen real-world deployment.

Optional Databricks AutoML

Not executed in this local run. The supplied Databricks notebook performs the comparison in an authenticated compatible workspace; no AutoML score is claimed here.

Measured transfer result

Classification ROC-AUC is 0.9972 on the internal test and 0.6162 on the external file. The external top-decile lift is 0.8909. A lift below 1 means the selected top decile has a lower observed churn rate than the external population average.

External regression RMSE is 265.8363, versus 276.1474 for the training-mean baseline; R² is -0.0384. Negative R² compares against the external file's own mean, which is not the deployable training-mean baseline.

The chosen specification does not demonstrate reliable transfer to this external file. Candidate registration records an experiment; it is not a decision to deploy the model.

Interpretation and limits

High internal discrimination is not sufficient evidence of generalization to the other file. Conditional label relationships, ID associations and feature distributions differ. This is not proof of temporal concept drift, target leakage or causality. The data card does not establish a real business sampling process or observation horizon. No retention intervention effect or monetary ROI is estimated.

Local Spark/MLflow execution is recorded in the manifest. Databricks notebooks and the optional AutoML comparison require an authenticated compatible workspace; local execution is not evidence of a cloud run.
